name: Ducati Indiana
engine: 649 or 748 cc air-cooled belt-driven desmo V-twin, two carbs
intro: Ducati's Cagiva-era cruiser. A Pantah-family engine in a custom frame, and rare now.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
